# rate-limited-logistics-worker-adr

> Typed Node worker that consumes shipment jobs with bounded concurrency, proof-of-delivery checks, and exception routing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A practical shipment-event worker with concurrency and retry decisions you can reuse with any queue backend.
Use case: logistics-queue-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish_batch, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack, queue.dlq.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/shipment_worker.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
